name: Li-FT Power Ltd.
summary: Li-FT Power Ltd. is a mineral exploration company that acquires, explores and develops lithium-rich pegmatite deposits in Canada. The wholly owned Yellowknife Lithium Project in the Northwest Territories is its most significant holding, and it has stakes in other regional lithium projects including DeStaffany, LDG and Mackay. Founded in 2021, it is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
